title: Jab kabhi gheerate insaa'n ka
body:
Jab kabhi gheerate insaa'n ka sawaal aata hai
Binte zahra tere parde ka qayaal aata hai
Darmiyaa'n laasho ke tanha nazar aate hai hussain
Jab ke aashoor ke sooraj pa zawaal aata hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Mout kis sonch me hai laashae akber pa khadi
Kya payambar ki jawaani ka qayaal aata hai
Mutthiyaa'n bheenj ke pheri hai zabaa'n hoto'n par
jab ke shashmaahe pa hyder ka jalaal aata hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Badh ke abbas kaleje se laga lete hai
Jab sakina ki yateemi ka qayaal aata hai
Kya hataaega koi nehr se qaime sheh ke
Baazue sibte payambar ko jalaal aata hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Khoo'n bhara kurta utha leti hai badhkar zainab
Jab ke darbaar me loota hua maal aata hai
